Nippon Electric Glass.why: Supplies glass wafers for supporting semiconductors and probe-card glass substrates and is jointly developing inorganic (glass / glass-ceramic) core substrates with semiconductor companies for advanced packaging; also low-expansion glass fiber for package substrates.
Nippon Electric Glass.evidence: Nippon Electric Glass 2Q FY2026 results presentation 08-03-2026: inorganic core substrates (GC Core, glass core substrate) in joint development with semiconductor companies, commercialization expected in 2028 or later; glass wafer for supporting semiconductors (WSG) demand expected to recover in H2.

players.product: Glass wafers for supporting semiconductors (WSG carrier glass) and glass substrates for probe cards; inorganic core substrates (GC Core glass-ceramic core and glass core substrate) under joint development with semiconductor companies

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results presentation: Financial Results for 2Q of FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2Q FY2026 (H1 accumulated): net sales 156.4 billion yen, up 1.7% year on year; operating profit 11.3 billion yen (margin 7.3%), down 31.2%; Q2 net sales 81.3 billion yen and operating profit 4.8 billion yen. Electronics & Information Technology sales 88.7 billion yen in H1 (displays approx. 80%, electronics approx. 20%). Business restructuring expenses of 12.6 billion yen recorded in Q2 as an extraordinary loss, mainly for structural reforms at the U.S. composites subsidiary; the company decided to withdraw from glass fiber production in North America.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales 156.4 billion yen (+1.7%); operating profit 11.3 billion yen

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results presentation: Financial Results for 2Q of FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 forecast revised on July 31: net sales 300.0 billion yen, operating profit 20.0 billion yen (from 33.0 billion yen announced February 6), ordinary profit 25.0 billion yen, profit attributable to owners of parent 15.0 billion yen; assumptions 1 USD = 160 JPY, 1 EUR = 185 JPY. Reasons given: lower display sales volume, delayed productivity improvement in composites, higher raw material and fuel prices and costs of closing European and U.S. composites sites.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 net sales 300.0 billion yen; operating profit 20.0 billion yen (from 33.0 billion yen)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results presentation: Financial Results for 2Q of FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor-related products (about 35% of the electronic device business, full year FY2026): sales of glass wafer for supporting semiconductors (WSG) in H1 FY2026 fell below the same period last year but demand is expected to recover in the second half; glass substrates for probe cards see strong demand and sales are expected to increase in the second half; inorganic core substrates (GC Core, glass core substrate) are under joint development with semiconductor companies, with commercialization expected in 2028 or later. Company: demand for manufacturing process materials and materials for advanced packaging is expected to increase.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor about 35% of electronic device business; core substrate commercialization 2028 or later

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results presentation: Financial Results for 2Q of FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Composites: active investment in low-dielectric glass fiber (D2 Fiber) for substrate materials for telecommunications and other applications, with the deck showing first generation production start in Q4 FY2026, second generation in 1Q FY2027 and a capacity expansion study by end of FY2027; low-expansion glass fiber for semiconductor package substrate applications is in manufacturing-process development and sample work.
quarterly_data.figure: first generation Q4 FY2026; second generation 1Q FY2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results presentation: Financial Results for 2Q of FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Information and communications (about 25% of the electronic device business): sales of data center-related products were strong and are expected to exceed initial plans; microcapillaries are used in optical transceivers, wavelength selective filters, isolators and co-packaged optics (CPO), and glass polarizers in optical isolators; the company's demand forecast charts show approx. 4.5 times for microcapillaries and about 8 times for glass polarizers over 2023-2028.
quarterly_data.figure: microcapillary demand approx. 4.5 times; glass polarizer about 8 times

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results presentation: Financial Results for 2Q of FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital investment planned at approx. 45 billion yen in FY2026 (display all-electric melting, capacity expansion and productivity; composites investment in D2 low-dielectric glass fiber) and depreciation approx. 26 billion yen.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex approx. 45 billion yen; depreciation approx. 26 billion yen
